const myBank= "tr909"

$kick: sound("bd(<5 7>,16)").bank(myBank).n(3).duckorbit(2).duckattack(0.2).duckdepth(1)._punchcard()
$clap: sound("[- cp:2 ]*2").bank(myBank).lpf(3700).delay(.2)
 $hh: s("hh!8").gain(.2).bank(myBank).sometimesBy(.1, x => x.ply("2 | 4")).n(1).delay(.05)

  .sound("sawtooth")
  .slow(2)
  .attack(.3)
  .release(2)

  .room(0.9)
  .gain(0.3)

$lead: n("<4 2 ~ 4 6 2 1 4 0 ~ 4 2 3 ~>")

  .attack(.05)
  .release(.5)

samples('github:switchangel/pad')

.scrub(irand(16).div(16).seg(8)
.rib("<5 20>", 1).almostNever(ply("2 | 4"))
).n("<0@3 1>").gain(.6)
.orbit(2).distort("2:.5")._scope()

]

$: s("swpad").scrub(pick(chops, "<0@3 [1 2]>")).att(.3).n(2).note("<c2@3 c3>").room(1).roomsize(4).phaser(.3).gain(1.5)._spectrum()

/*
@by Kannomaly
@title Grimes
*/
await osc()

setcpm(135/4)
//VOCAL
$: s("grimes_vocal").mask("<1 0 0 0 0 0 0 0>").orbit(3).distort("2:.5").gain(.9).room(.4).roomsize(2)

//KICK
$: s("rolandtr909_bd:5!4")
  .duck(3)
  .duckdepth(.8)
  .duckattack(.16)
  .gain(1.05)
  ._scope()
$: s("rolandtr909_bd:5!4").osc()


//HH1
$: s("hh:2").beat("1,3,5,7", 8).bank("tr909").fit().o(5).gain(rand.range(.5,.7))
._pianoroll()
//HH2
$: s("hh: 16!16").bank("tr909").o(9).dec(.1).fm(time).fmh(time). gain(.7).pan(rand).room(.3)._spiral({steady: .96})

//CLAP
$: s("cp:4").beat("1,3",4).bank("tr909").gain(1.2)

//WHITE NOISE
$: s("white!4").att(.4).o(6).gain(.3).lpf(slider(100, 0, 100).pow(2))

//BASS
$: cat(
  note("c2"),
  note("g1"),
  note("eb1"),
  cat(note("eb1"), note("f1")).fast(2),
  note("c2"),
  cat(note("g1"), note("bb1")).fast(2),
  note("eb1"),
  note("f1")
)
.s("supersaw")
.distort("2:.8")
.lpf(5000)
.orbit(3)

//PAD
$: cat(
  note("c5"),
  note("g4"),
  note("eb4"),
  cat(note("eb4"), note("f4")).fast(2),
  note("c5"),
  cat(note("g4"), note("bb4")).fast(2),
  note("eb4"),
  note("f4")
)
.s("gm_pad_warm:3")
.distort("2:.3")
.lpf(5000)
.orbit(3)

//LEAD
$: cat(
  note("- - eb5 - - d5 - bb4"),
  note("- - bb4 - - a4 - g4"),
  note("- - g4 - - f4 - g4"),
  note("- - g4 - - f4 - g4"),
  note("- - eb5 - - d5 - bb4"),
  note("- - bb4 - bb4 c5 - g4"),
  note("- - g4 - - f4 - g4"),
  note("- - g4 - - a4 - a4")
)
.n(1)
.sound("gm_lead_1_square:2")
.decay(.95)
.delay(".3:.225:.45")
.room(.4)
.rsize(2)
.distort("2:.4")
.phaser(4)
.gain(.5)
